families.name: descriptor-only queries
inputs: native canonical/byte-swapped descriptor identity and pair
all legacy numeric relation cells per actual ABI
S/U size, temporal multiplier, fields/subarrays and managed/custom descriptor parameters
families.cost_scope: Builtin fixed-descriptor cases can be payload-independent; arbitrary callbacks, Python-int discovery, descriptor parsing and field recursion have separate costs.

families.name: multi-input promotion
inputs: strong descriptor/array sublists interleaved with exact weak scalars
structured recursion and custom callback knowledge-order cases
families.cost_scope: Use exact source reduction and recursive metadata cost; do not assume universal associative LUB or constant work for custom callback programs.

families.name: payload cast boundary
inputs: same_value, complex warnings, object/NA finalization and temporaries
measure: analytical numeric bounds and lifecycle failures
families.cost_scope: Separate future execution contract; can_cast True or source-safe label is not payload correctness/performance evidence.

hardware: Native NumPy query policy is host metadata work; real CPU ABI/ISA builds and every actually exposed first-party/device callback or payload target need separate receipts. No silent CPU fallback qualifies an accelerator class.
required_receipts: zero skipped cells counted as verification
derived numerical bounds before empirical thresholds
statistical uncertainty and synchronized end-to-end timing
qualification_budget: not set; mathematical/workload justification required before performance qualification
